judgements.name: opencode-devcontainers
reasons: Criterion 3 warning: repository is archived (no active maintainer).
Criterion 5 info: no egress declared, so network behavior cannot be verified yet.
judgements.user_note: This plugin can remain listed in community with a warning until maintainership and egress declaration are addressed.

judgements.name: opencode-dynamic-context-pruning
reasons: Criterion 1 warning: license is AGPL-3.0-or-later (OSI-approved copyleft) and should be clearly disclosed to users
Criterion 5 info: no egress is declared, which is required before network behavior can be verified
judgements.user_note: This plugin is available, but note it uses AGPL copyleft terms and has not yet declared egress for verification.

judgements.name: opencode-conductor
reasons: Warning (criterion 6): runs a postinstall script on install (`node scripts/postinstall.cjs`), so it needs review before verification.
Info (criterion 5): no egress is declared, which is needed before network behavior can be verified.
judgements.user_note: This plugin can remain listed in community status, but users should review the postinstall script and treat network behavior as unverified until egress is declared.

judgements.name: opencode-sentry-monitor
reasons: warn (criterion 2): no public source repository found
info (criterion 5): no egress declared (needed before it can be verified)
judgements.user_note: This plugin can remain listed in community status, but it should disclose a public source repository and declared egress before stronger trust status is considered.
